title: Prove H6 commuting dyadic repairs need rank 816 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove a scoped obstruction for the fixed H6 source complement over D=Z[1/2]: a dyadic correction B with BK=KB and I-K+B in GL(D) has exact minimum rational rank **816**. In fact, ker B is contained in ker K. Every polynomial correction is covered, and arbitrary mixing inside repeated eigenspaces is allowed.

```text
Unrestricted dyadic repair: 560, cited from Ross Richardson #3655
Commuting dyadic repair:    816, this proof
Rank-560 repair:            must break commutation with K
```

B=K attains 816 by cancelling the kernel response. This is an algebraic sharpness witness, not a useful source encoder. The contribution is a **scoped written proof with finite exact corroboration**, not a new kappa or a physical supplier. The invariant saturated kernel of B must carry a dyadic automorphism, which excludes all three nonunit characteristic factors of I-K.

Only the six-file `research/h6-commuting-repair/` package is added. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Ross Richardson #3655 supplies the H6 spectrum, symmetry and unrestricted 560-row completion as cited premises; those results are not replayed or audited here. Credit Dominik Scholz #606, DreamingOfClouds' H6/Walsh proposal, and the retained #1830 spectral, compensation and encoder lineage. PID module facts and characteristic polynomials are classical.

## Evidence

Before, the cited 560-row completion left a paid physical synthesis open. After, the new proof shows that no commuting or polynomial correction can realize it at rank 560. Such a synthesis must break commutation or change the endpoint contract.

- Exact enumeration covers 390,625 ordered small matrix pairs, including 12,465 commuting pairs and 6,552 with a dyadic-unit repaired determinant. Every accepted pair satisfies the general rank obstruction; 1,856 attain their bound.
- 36 dyadic conjugations check literal abstract attaining endpoints. Three altered factor certificates, four hypothesis controls and ten invalid certificates pass. Noncommuting and odd-denominator examples show why the hypotheses matter.
- Local warning-strict CPython 3.12.15 normal and optimized commands pass, timed individually at 0.080 and 0.085 seconds. The registered replay passes in 0.412 seconds. These are timeout checks, not performance improvement claims.
- Source pins, exact six-file committed bytes, executable modes and declared source history pass at `6df64badfa3b1c2680c8306b863c4a4ca187a8d5`. Official committed export integrity and a read-only, Git-free optimized replay with an empty executable PATH pass. Exported bytes and sealed modes remain unchanged. The verifier emits a generated SHA256-bound receipt without writing files.
- JSON parsing, Python compilation and AST inspection pass; all functions are below 60 lines. No external linter was available. Registered runs enable warnings as errors.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/h6-commuting-repair/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/h6-commuting-repair/verify.py

/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/h6-commuting-repair --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Another CPython 3.12 executable may replace the local path. Direct output ends `PASS_H6_COMMUTING_REPAIR rank=816 no_new_kappa`; the launcher ends `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`. The universal H6 statement rests on PROOF.md and the cited spectral premise, not a finite full-H6 enumeration.

Canonical base is `19fdb086ea96af9a9f87936a2b888e10af4ed810`, priority revision 8. The decoder card is explicitly changed to this fixed-source algebraic side obstruction. The selected metadata baseline passes. Live PRs, Discussions, main package statements and merged H6 work were checked before the [advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19228563) and refreshed before committing. The broad overlap snapshot covered 393 open PRs and 5,638 Discussion records; local sparse omissions were supplemented with main-tree and merged-PR searches. This is not an exhaustive novelty certificate.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The matrix dimension and dyadic coefficient ring are fixed. Noncommuting corrections, odd-denominator rational coefficients and stable extensions are outside this theorem. Correction rank is not a paid native-call count. The rank-816 witness removes the kernel response rather than implementing the intended source map.

No dense H6 matrix reconstruction, predecessor spectrum/Smith/repair replay, paid native word, source-frame synthesis, dirty-helper restoration, complete cost/precision/tape/stock calculation, supplier admission or selected cold replay was run. No registered scientific command is left for CI alone. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. The selected frontier is unchanged.

## Open next questions

- Construct explicit noncommuting coefficients for the cited 560-row completion and price their actual source-frame access, scalar work and dirt restoration. Those coefficients and a physical word remain missing.
- Test an enlarged dirty-helper interface only with a declared arbitrary-input endpoint and complete paid/target invoice. Stable extensions can evade this fixed-dimensional obstruction but carry new restoration and hosting obligations.

## Related open work

The completion refresh inspected this account's twelve other open PRs created since the advance CLAIM: #6016 through #6022 and #6024 through #6028. None computes the fixed-H6 commuting-repair quantity or reports a competing rank-816/rank-560 value. No additional scientific computations were run to compare or validate those works.

- [#6019](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6019) proves chronological helper-spill and cross-bank repair ranks. Its matrix, coefficient constraint and endpoint differ from fixed-H6 commuting repair; no common numerical repair rank is computed or compared.
- [#6027](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6027) decides paired 2-integral lattices with rank-one projector anchors. It supplies no H6 repair or decoder rank, so no numerical comparison is made.

Merged #3655 is the cited unrestricted predecessor. Merged #3649 and #5233 change fitting-kernel families; this result fixes K and studies source-map repairs.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way. One isolated research package can be reverted independently.

**Blast radius:** research. Shared code, frozen predecessors and selected records are unchanged.
